title: WHO: ischaemic heart disease killed 9.5 million people in 2023
summary: The same fact sheet calls ischaemic heart disease the biggest killer, 16 percent of deaths, 9.5 million in 2023.
body: WHO's 2 October 2026 fact sheet says the world's biggest killer is ischaemic heart disease, responsible for 16 percent of the world's total deaths. It says deaths from this disease rose by 3.0 million from 2000, to 9.5 million in 2023. A separate WHO cardiovascular-disease sheet gives a 2022 total for all cardiovascular diseases, which is a wider group and a different year. The 9.5 million figure is this sheet's 2023 estimate for ischaemic heart disease.
